summary: Frontend-only test of double-episode support for multi-part cards. The app ran in a simulated Electron bridge (Proxy electronAPI, library file in sessionStorage) with TMDB mocked through page.context.route. Every requested scenario passed. AUTO-SUGGEST: 'Show.S07E11', 'Show.S07E12E13.1080p' and 'Show.S07E14' were grouped into one suggestion with 3 parts, so the double episode is no longer ignored. Merging gave one card with parts in the order S07E11, S07E12E13, S07E14. LABELS: the parts list and the parts-play-dialog both show 'S07E11', 'S07E12-E13', 'S07E14'. play-part-1 in the play dialog opened the S07E12E13 file. SERIES INFO: series-info-btn made exactly 3 calls: /search/tv?query=Show, /tv/77, /tv/77/season/7. Only season 7 was requested. part-episode-name-0 = 'Eleven · 40 min', part-episode-name-1 = 'Twelve A / Twelve B · 45 min', part-episode-name-2 = 'Fourteen'. Toast: 'Matched series "Show" — 3 of 3 parts matched to episodes'. The saved episode is {season 7, number 12, last_number 13, name 'Twelve A / Twelve B', overview 'OA\n\nOB', still from ep 12, runtime 45}. NOT DOUBLE: 'Doc.S01E02 1080p', 'Doc.S01E03.2019' and 'Doc.S01E04-720p' are labelled S01E02, S01E03, S01E04 and are grouped. EXTRA FORMATS: S02E05-E06 -> S02E05-E06, s02e07.e08 -> S02E07-E08, S02E09-10 -> S02E09-E10, S02E11E12E13 -> S02E11-E13. REGRESSION: The Green Planet - Part 1..3 still groups and merges, is labelled Part 1..3, and maps to /tv/500/season/1 episodes 1..3 (Tropical Worlds · 58 min, Water Worlds, Seasonal Worlds) with toast '3 of 3 parts matched'.

issues: The label span is fixed at w-14, so 'S07E12-E13' wraps onto two lines ('S07E12-' / 'E13') in the modal and in the play dialog. Use w-auto/min-w-14 with whitespace-nowrap, or about w-20.

action_items: LOW: Stop double-episode labels wrapping in PartsList (w-14 -> min-w-[3.5rem] whitespace-nowrap).
critical_code_review_comments: PART_PATTERNS[0] accepts a bare '-NNN' after the episode as the end of a range. A name like 'Show.S01E04-480.mkv' or 'S01E04-720.mkv' (a resolution number with no 'p') would become S01E04-E480/E720. Names like '-720p' and '-1080p' are safe because of the \b check. Consider capping the bare-dash form at 2 digits or requiring end - start to be small.
attachEpisodes sets number and last_number, but the label still comes from the filename. That is fine. Note that 'S07E12-E13' where TMDB only has ep 12 gives last_number null, which is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. All seed data was in browser sessionStorage 'fakeLibFile'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same harness as iteration_22. The init script sets the electronAPI Proxy (getLicense -> {subscription_tier:'free'}, getDrives, listDirectory -> [], library*Sync via sessionStorage 'fakeLibFile', openPath records paths to window.__opened). TMDB is mocked with page.context.route('https://api.themoviedb.org/**'). Open the modal by clicking the h3 card title. Open the play dialog with the 'Play a Part...' button. Labels are in [data-testid=parts-list] span.text-primary. Each browser_automation call is a fresh context, so seed the library again every run.
